title: Fall Festival Watercolor Cliparts Autumn
author: CozyNest Studio
description:
🍂🎃 A cozy collection of autumn festival watercolor clipart featuring pumpkins, apple harvest scenes, cozy market stands, vintage pickup trucks, Ferris wheels, fall decorations, pumpkin patch elements, warm seasonal drinks, and charming countryside illustrations. Created in a modern commercial watercolor style with warm pumpkin orange, golden beige, sage green, cream, caramel, and rich autumn tones, this collection captures the inviting atmosphere of fall festivals, harvest markets, apple orchards, and cozy autumn weekends.
✨ Perfect for:
• Print on Demand products
• Stickers and sticker sheets
• Scrapbooking projects
• Journals and planners
• Greeting cards and invitations
• Seasonal home decor
• Social media graphics
• Digital and printable crafts
• Autumn and harvest-themed designs
• Fall market and farmhouse merchandise
🤍 What’s included:
– 24 high-quality illustrations
– Transparent background
– High resolution – 300 DPI (perfect for print & digital use)
– 24 PNG files (transparent background)
– 24 SVG files
🍁 Included illustrations:
Ferris wheel decorated with pumpkins, pumpkin and hay bale arrangement, apple basket, glowing lantern jar, pumpkin patch entrance, autumn picnic table, cozy pumpkin bench, harvest wagon, farm market stand, sunflower basket, pumpkin ladder display, autumn floral arch, woven blanket basket, autumn festival ticket, harvest produce stand, vintage green pickup truck filled with pumpkins, pumpkin collection, caramel apple, cozy boots, rustic lantern, pumpkin spice latte, wooden autumn signpost, apple tree, large heirloom pumpkin etc.
✨ Inspired by autumn festivals, pumpkin patches, harvest celebrations, apple orchards, cozy countryside weekends, farm markets, seasonal fairs, rustic fall decor, warm drinks, colorful autumn foliage, farmhouse aesthetics, crisp October mornings, Thanksgiving gatherings, and the comforting atmosphere of the fall season. These illustrations are perfect for creating cozy, elegant, and seasonal designs that celebrate the beauty of autumn and harvest traditions.
